lines.zh: 我踩着步子，粉白相间的身子一晃一晃。
lines.en: I strut along, my pink and white body swaying.
I walk very lightly, almost silently.

lines.zh: 我沿着墓园的方向过去。
lines.en: I head off toward the old yard.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在听节拍。
lines.en: I stop with each step, as if hearing a beat.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，又走进雾里。
lines.en: I come out of the mist and back into it.

lines.zh: 我的脚抬得很高，落得很轻。
lines.en: I lift my feet high and set them down softly.

lines.zh: 我在灰烬原那边转了一圈。
lines.en: I make a turn around the ashen fields.
My head stays tilted as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，没踢响一颗。
lines.en: I go around the stones without kicking one.
My tail sways with every step.
I drift over toward the woods.
I walk on my toes.

lines.zh: 我站着，脸上那片黑在发光。
lines.en: I stand still, the black of my face glowing.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一张一合，没有声音。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes without sound.
I tilt my head as if smiling.
My eyes glow into a thin line.
I hold this pose a long while.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，停在半空。
lines.en: I lift a hand and stop it in the air.
I am waiting for an audience.

lines.zh: 静电在我脸前拉开一道横线。
lines.en: Static draws a horizontal line across my face.
I look down at my own feet.

lines.zh: 我安静得只有微弱的电流声。
lines.en: I am so quiet only a faint hum remains.
You came; I have waited a long time.

lines.zh: 我的脸上写着几个字母。
lines.en: There are letters on my face.
Can you read them? I will not explain.
I turn my head so you can see clearly.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，没有温度。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me without warmth.
I watch you the whole time, my mouth moving.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我的画面也闪了一下。
lines.en: When you blink, my image flickers too.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就前倾一点。
lines.en: You step back half a pace and I lean in.
My eyes have no pupils.
Are you going to stay?
My face flickers several times.
I tilt and correct my posture.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我笑得更大了。
lines.en: You hit me and my smile widens.

lines.zh: 裂缝里有紫色的光漏出来。
lines.en: Purple light leaks out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我卡住了一秒，才继续动。
lines.en: I freeze for a second before moving again.
The hum turns harsh.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂下来，晃了晃。
lines.en: My arm drops and swings a little.
I step back, head still facing you.
That blow slowed my movements.

lines.zh: 我笑着，把歪掉的部分按回去。
lines.en: Smiling, I push the bent part back.
What you hold gives off light.
That sound, I follow it.
You beckoned to me, did you not?
Raise the light a little higher.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿别动，我过来。
lines.en: Stand still; I am coming over.
The current in you is loud.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有什么在响。
lines.en: Something rattles in your pocket.
I walk toward that small noise.

lines.zh: 你叫我？我听不见，可我知道。
lines.en: Did you call? I cannot hear, but I know.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，很自然。
lines.en: I follow your footsteps, quite naturally.
I touch you, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的脸闪了一下。
lines.en: We collide and my face flickers.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers find your wrist.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我站着没动。
lines.en: You collide with me and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我的外壳发亮。
lines.en: We brush past and my shell gleams.
Pushed crooked, I keep smiling.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一歪，你就知道是我。
lines.en: One tilt of my ears and you know it is me.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我发出哔的一声。
lines.en: At the impact I make a beep.

lines.zh: 我们分开后，你身上有静电。
lines.en: After we part, there is static on you.
I reach up and straighten your hat.

lines.zh: 我是一台机器，没有那回事。
lines.en: I am a machine; there is no such thing.
My face is only for performing.

lines.zh: 我的程序里没写这一条。
lines.en: That line is not in my program.
I tilt my head, uncomprehending.
That is not my line.
I smile once and turn away.
This conversation is rather dull.
I blink, and it is only a simulation.
Only sound interests me.
You ask, and I pretend not to hear.

lines.zh: 我夹起来，指尖抖了一下。
lines.en: I pinch it up, and my fingertip twitches.
I hold it up to my eye.
This thing makes noise; interesting.
I tuck it into my chest.
I pick it up and drop it again.
I pick it up and shake it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我替你保管。
lines.en: You dropped this; I will keep it safe.
I hold it before my face to hide.
I set it down without a sound.
I will keep this one to play with.

lines.zh: 我选你了，观众只有一个。
lines.en: I choose you; one audience member is enough.
My face turns toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 你把我的注意力带走了。
lines.en: You have taken my attention.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，没有别的意思。
lines.en: I am walking to you, with no other meaning.
Your heartbeat keeps good time.

lines.zh: 我要看着你，直到你离开。
lines.en: I will watch you until you leave.
You are the only one here tonight.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住了你的位置。
lines.en: My eyes have locked your position.
Where you stand is just right.

lines.zh: 屏幕上的我，转过来看你。
lines.en: The me on the screen turns to look at you.
I have started following you.
Step away and I will keep up.
Smiling, I come closer, slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子进了我的视野。
lines.en: Your shadow has entered my view.
I have memorised this spot.
You have been picked.
I am a few steps behind you.
You walk, and I walk.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的方向缓缓移动。
lines.en: I drift along your direction.
I only stand and look around.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很轻，你听不到。
lines.en: My steps are too light for you to hear.
You go behind a tree, and so do I.
The distance between us has never changed.
I can match my pauses to your breathing.
You walk faster, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我一直走在你的斜后方。
lines.en: I keep to your rear quarter.
I have learnt your route.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我在另一边。
lines.en: You look up for me; I am on the other side.
I make no sound; I only follow.
You stop, and I stop.
I am content with this distance.

lines.zh: 你身后总有那么一点动静。
lines.en: There is always a small sound behind you.

lines.zh: 我的静电擦过你的后颈，很轻。
lines.en: My static brushes the back of your neck, faintly.

lines.zh: 你走得再远，也就是几步。
lines.en: However far you go, it is only a few steps.
I am waiting for you to turn around.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直对着你的背。
lines.en: My face stays turned to your back.

lines.zh: 我抬手，很快地拍你一下。
lines.en: I raise a hand and swat you quickly.

lines.zh: 我的手指勾住你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers hook your sleeve.
That blow carried static.
I push you, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我拍你的肩，紫光闪了一下。
lines.en: I pat your shoulder and a purple flash blinks out.
I strike while smiling, and abruptly.
My fingertip catches you.

lines.zh: 我的手臂从奇怪的角度过来。
lines.en: My arm comes from a strange angle.
I pat your shoulder, and you flinch.
I catch your wrist, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 这一下不快，可你没躲开。
lines.en: It was not fast, and you did not dodge.

lines.zh: 我抬手打在你的手背上。
lines.en: I strike the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我的外壳撞到你，闷响一声。
lines.en: My shell hits you with a dull knock.
I pull back and smile once.

lines.zh: 我的指尖带着静电划过你的脖子。
lines.en: My fingertip, charged with static, grazes your neck.
I am not angry; this is the show.
You fall back two steps, so I stop.

lines.zh: 我的动作卡了一下，然后打中。
lines.en: My movement stutters, then lands.
I grab your scarf and pull.
This shell of mine is plastic.

lines.zh: 我先亮起来，然后才出现。
lines.en: I light up first, and only then appear.

lines.zh: 雾里浮出一张发光的脸。
lines.en: A glowing face floats up out of the mist.
I come walking from the old yard.

lines.zh: 我站在树下，粉白得刺眼。
lines.en: I stand under the tree, garish in pink and white.

lines.zh: 你听见一声低低的电流。
lines.en: You hear a low hum of current.
I straighten up in the middle of the ashen fields.

lines.zh: 我的嘴先动，然后身体才动。
lines.en: My mouth moves first, then my body.

lines.zh: 我从夜里切进来，像一帧错误。
lines.en: I cut into the night like a bad frame.
I appear at your side, head tilted.

lines.zh: 我的脸先亮起，身子才跟上。
lines.en: My face lights up first; my body follows.
My eyes brighten little by little.

lines.zh: 一块紫色像素掉在地上，是我。
lines.en: A purple pixel falls to the ground, and it is me.

lines.zh: 火一烤，粉色的漆起了泡。
lines.en: Fire blisters the pink paint.
I fall and one leg snaps.

lines.zh: 水浸了电路，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Water reaches my circuits and I jolt.
The blast flips me face up.

lines.zh: 箭插在我的脸上，还在抖。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my face and quivers.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，我的字全乱了。
lines.en: A spell sweeps over and my letters scramble.

lines.zh: 电量见底，我的声音变小了。
lines.en: Battery low, my voice fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈进来，我全身亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body flares.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下揪，我还在笑。
lines.en: The void hauls me down and I am still smiling.
